cells.gaps: The sector policy's period ended in 2020 and no successor sector policy is on record as adopted or in preparation: what followed it is the Politique nationale du numérique 2021-2030, classed national. Nothing is held on the policy's text, on a mandated body or finance, or on any event in the twelve months to the as-at.
cells.note: Document de politique sectorielle des télécommunications et des TIC 2013-2020: adopted by decree 2013-158 of 12 April 2013, its period ended in 2020. Only a sector policy counts as its successor and the national digital strategy followed it, so the cell is unplaced rather than stage 2.
